methodologyNotes: Covers residential point-of-use reverse osmosis drinking-water systems sold at a published US price, including under-sink (pressurized-tank), tankless under-sink, and plug-in countertop units. Excludes whole-house RO, commercial/industrial RO, and non-RO filters (pitcher, carbon-only, UF-only). Price is typical US MSRP in USD. installType is one of under-sink, tankless-under-sink, or countertop. filtrationStages is the manufacturer-stated number of filtration stages (integer count). ratedCapacityGpd is rated permeate production in gallons per day (GPD). pureToDrainRatio is the pure-water-to-wastewater ratio written X:1 (higher X = more efficient; a value below 1:1 wastes more than it makes). tdsReductionPct is the manufacturer-claimed total-dissolved-solids reduction as a percent. remineralization is a boolean: true if the system adds minerals or alkaline pH back to permeate. requiresElectricity is a boolean: true for pump-driven or countertop units that must be plugged in, false for gravity/line-pressure units. storageTankGal is usable clean-water storage in gallons (pressurized tank or countertop reservoir); 0 for pure on-demand tankless systems. nsfCertifiedStandards lists the NSF/ANSI standards the unit is third-party certified to (e.g. "58, 53, 42"), or "none" if uncertified. membraneLifeMonths is the manufacturer-rated RO membrane replacement interval in months. annualFilterCostUsd is the typical yearly replacement-filter cost in USD. Values are null if not disclosed by the manufacturer.

products.name: Cloud RO
products.priceNote: Cloud Water Filters official store page (cloudwaterfilters.com/buy/cloud-ro) lists the Cloud RO at "$649" with a current "$50 OFF" promo (net $599). Using $649 as the manufacturer list/MSRP (the only price printed verbatim on the manufacturer page). The Quality Water Lab review independently states "Unit Cost: $599" (the promo/street price).
products.provenance: The Cloud Water Filters official store page (source) confirms this exact model — "Cloud RO, Under Sink Reverse Osmosis System" — with a 2.8-gallon holding tank, a battery-powered internal hydraulic pump ("battery powered so no electrical hookup is required"), an integrated remineralization stage, NSF 58 certification, a listed price of $649 ($50-off promo to $599), and replacement filters averaging $200-$250/year. The Quality Water Lab hands-on lab review (corroboration, dated Sep 2025) independently confirms the same Cloud RO unit and its "4-stage RO" design (sediment, carbon block, RO membrane, remineralization), "1:1 pure-to-waste ratio," 2.8-gallon tank, NSF/ANSI 58 certification, ~$200/year filter cost, and a $599 unit cost. ratedCapacityGpd is null because sources disagree (manufacturer-rated "up to 80 GPD" membrane production per WaterFilterGuru vs. a 600 GPD marketed "flow rate" on QWL — neither is a clean methodology-aligned permeate-production figure on the cited corroboration); membraneLifeMonths (reviews split 18 vs 24 mo; manufacturer uses usage-based, not fixed-interval, replacement) and tdsReductionPct (no specific manufacturer TDS% claim) are likewise null.

products.name: Waterdrop G3 P800

products.provenance: The official Waterdrop product page (model WD-G3P800-W-FC) confirms this exact G3P800 as an 800 GPD tankless under-sink RO system with 10-stage filtration, a 3:1 pure-to-drain ratio, IAPMO R&T certification to NSF/ANSI 42, 53, 58 and 372, "Electricity Required: Yes", and a 24-month (G3P800-N2RO) RO-membrane replacement interval; it is a distinct SKU from the separate "G3P800 Remineralization RO System," so this base unit is non-remineralizing. The Amazon WaterdropDirect listing (ASIN B0987FCQQW) corroborates the identical model and specs (SGS-tested 10-stage, 800 GPD, 3:1 pure-to-drain, NSF/ANSI 42&53&58&372, corded electric, tankless). Neither the manufacturer nor Amazon page exposed a system price; a third retailer (Home Outlet Direct, same SKU) listed $999.00, but that figure is atypically high and variant-ambiguous, so priceUsd is left null.
